policy: reference canonical registry; do not replace or reclassify existing cleared states
inheritance: General requirements apply to all descendants unless explicitly superseded by approved owner-specific policy. No lower-level record may remove a security/CCK requirement.

records.title: Independent runtime engine and presentation
records.requirement: Automata headless power remains independent of appearance and Suit. Changing a face does not restart services.

records.title: Private control tower and selective frontend publication
records.requirement: Private administration distinct from published frontend; each element requires server-side permission and per-audience publication contract.

records.title: Independent backend extension/plugin lifecycle
records.requirement: Discover, register, enable, disable, upgrade, uninstall and rollback backend capability extensions with dependency, authority and proof.

records.title: Independent frontend extension/plugin lifecycle
records.requirement: View/furniture extensions cannot silently acquire backend rights; typed capability bindings required.

records.title: Independent ACT face, skin and layout switches
records.requirement: ACT dashboard, FastLook, Hello and Father/Pocket source-owned faces selectable without duplicating engine, with persistent layout/skin and accessibility proof.

records.title: Page-to-element drill-down and inherited obligations
records.requirement: Catalog traverses app/global > page > concept > section > container > feature > module > row > element with stable IDs, CCK linkage, status, receipts, and visible breadcrumbs.

records.title: ACT selector in existing rail
records.requirement: Inspect real Automata rail and existing control identity before assigning a face-selector button; do not invent an icon or live binding.
